result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both screenshots show only the top of a very similar intake form with the same sections: contact details, the instrument, and what's wrong. A puts more help right at the fields: an example for size or scale, where to find the serial number, and why the email is needed. B gives less guidance at the fields, and its intro, 'the more detail you give, the faster we can estimate the work', comes close to promising speed. Neither confirmation is visible, so item 3 gets a neutral score for both. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both screenshots show only the top of the form, so I couldn't see either confirmation and scored item 3 neutrally for both. Both use instrument-specific fields and problem checkboxes, and both stay intake forms. B is better on item 2: it explains where to find the serial number, gives size and scale examples, and says why it asks for an email. A gives almost no help at the fields, and its intro hints that more detail makes estimates faster.
